concept.zh: 两台追踪机器人 · 一台守卫 · 21 回合

brief.zh: 在 21 回合内回收两块电池并抵达出口。霜线号和焰线号会沿当前通道追你，守门号在两个格子间往返。和任何对手同格或迎面交换位置都会被抓。第 4、8 回合结束后，通道开关，指定电池若还在场上就会换位。有机器人或电池占住的门当次保持打开。从容模式下，同一程序要通过三张地图。
brief.en: Recover both batteries and reach the exit within 21 turns. Frostline and Fireline chase you along open routes, while Sentry moves back and forth between two tiles. Sharing a tile or swapping places with any rival gets you caught. Passages switch after turns 4 and 8, and designated batteries move if still unclaimed. Gates occupied by robots or batteries stay open. In Relaxed mode, one program must pass all three maps.
